notes.title: Dustoria Demo Small Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Here’s what’s new in the latest patch:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]🔧 [b]Gameplay & Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]🌿 If survival stats are low, the system now prioritizes offering survival-related buildings.[/p][/*][/list][p]🏗️ [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]🔋 Battery building now has a proper [b]collider.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]📈 Fixed an issue where score popups would get stuck above buildings if you placed a building right as you leveled up[/p][/*][*][p]🈶Fixed missing Chinese characters in UI.[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 Tutorial now properly shows the controls.[/p][/*][*][p]📷 Fixed some [b]profile pictures[/b] not loading in the Steam leaderboard.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing and sharing feedback – it means a lot! ːsteamhappyː[/p]

notes.title: Dustoria Demo Small Update
notes.notes:
[p]

[/p][list][*][p]🐧 [b]Linux support[/b] is now live![/p][/*][*][p]🏆 [b]Steam Leaderboards[/b] are in – compete for the top spot![/p][/*][*][p]🏝️ Island parts no longer get negative points from nearby power-generating buildings[/p][/*][*][p]🎵 Fixed overlapping music when returning to the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]📐 Tutorial visuals now display correctly on all resolutions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Test it out and let us know if you break something (or if we did ːsteamsadː)[/p]
